checkout.canonicalization: RFC 8785 JSON Canonicalization Scheme followed by SHA-256
checkout.providerIdempotencyKey: deterministic opaque digest of contract version, storeId, and Idempotency-Key
persistenceSequence: insert pending record under a database uniqueness constraint
commit the canonical request hash and deterministic provider key
call the provider with that same deterministic provider key
retry interrupted pending records with the same provider key
checkout.sameKeySameCanonicalRequest: return the original session response without another provider call
checkout.sameKeyDifferentCanonicalRequest: return 409 IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT without another provider call
checkout.concurrentSameKey: serialize creation so exactly one provider call can win
checkout.expiredKey: a new session may be created after the retention window
